# Ismail Dawjee

**I make useful things and put them on the internet.**

### → [isdawjee.github.io](https://isdawjee.github.io/)

The full story is on the site, told in dots. This is the short version.

---

I'm a product and experience leader in Johannesburg. I design from the business model to the customer's moment,
and these days I build the software too.

### Now

- **CPTO, Immersion X.** The product company that grew out of my productisation strategy.
  Its first products are [Synergi](https://getsynergi.ai/) and Decoder, and I build them myself.
- **MD, Immersion Group.** Experience consulting and strategy: customer value propositions and experience
  strategy for banks, insurers and consumer brands. [immersion-group.com](https://immersion-group.com)
- **Judge, FNB App of the Year 2026.** Also FNB App of the Year 2024 and MTN App of the Year 2023.

### What I believe

> Design is how well a good intention is materialised, delivered and iterated.

I don't draw a line between the business model, the money and the customer. To me they're one thing,
and that's where the best experiences, sustainable businesses and real impact get made.

### Seventeen years, one direction: deeper

- **2009 · Pixels.** Design@Bay, Port Elizabeth: junior designer to art director, then a year freelance.
- **2014 · Journeys.** IBM: end-to-end customer journeys for some of the largest deals in the Middle East and Africa.
  Founding member of IBM iX South Africa.
- **2017 · Products.** Nedbank Digital Fast Lane: a bank account on a USSD menu for 1.4 million people,
  a digital Stokvel, and account opening entirely in the app.
- **2020 · Platforms & operating models.** Nedbank: business design lead on the Avo super-app redesign,
  strategy lead on the group's Target Operating Model 2.0.
- **2022 · Business models.** Immersion Group, then Immersion X: I wrote the strategy, and it became a company.

49 organisations, 7 sectors, 15 countries. From Eastern Cape universities to Gulf ministries, airlines, telcos,
banks and insurers.
